name: Kilimanjaro by the Marangu route
why: The oldest route up Kilimanjaro, with nights in huts instead of tents, across the saddle between Kibo and the jagged Mawenzi.
book: Kilimanjaro National Park fees per day, paid through a licensed operator: climbing without a registered guide and porters is not allowed. Most climbs start from Moshi. Huts at Mandara, Horombo and Kibo must be booked by the operator.
water: Water at the huts from springs: boiled by the crew.
dangers: Altitude: the summit is at 5,895 m. Headache, vomiting, confusion or breathlessness at rest: go down at once.
Summit night starts around midnight, -10 to -20 C with wind at the crater rim.
Afternoon storms and hail in the rainy months (March to May, November).
The route climbs fast: take the extra day at Horombo.
turnaround: Leave Kibo Hut at midnight; be at Gilman's Point by 06:30, or turn back.

points.name: Marangu Gate
points.note: The park gate above the Chagga village of Marangu, among coffee and banana gardens.

points.name: Mandara Hut
points.note: A-frame huts in the forest at 2,720 m, next to the Maundi crater.

points.name: Horombo Hut
points.note: Huts in the moorland at 3,720 m with Mawenzi and Kibo ahead.

points.name: Kibo Hut
points.note: A stone hut at 4,700 m on the bare saddle under the summit cone.

points.name: Uhuru Peak
points.note: The highest point of Africa, 5,895 m, on the crater rim.
